notes.title: Update 16/04/2020
notes.notes:
We updated the game by adding content and fixing bugs. In this update, bugs were fixed that spoiled the gameplay and occurred for almost all players at the very beginning of the game. The system of buildings was redesigned, and now buildings can be damaged by weapons. A bed was added. Also, for better communication, voice chat was added.
 Detailed list of changes. 
[olist]
 Added bed.
 Destruction of buildings added.
 Added voice chat.
 Added facial expressions of the character.
 Changed the texture of the tree.
 The bug with buildings was fixed when after installation of the building it was necessary to take another item.
 Fixed a problem with synchronization of clothes and weapons.
 A bug was fixed when a player who left the server at the time of his death and went back could not move.
 Fixed flashlight about running.
 Fixed a bug with the disappearance of the character and its preview with low graphics settings.
 Bug fixed when inventory was not synchronized at startup.
 Fixed bug with camera displacement after game settings.
 Fixed a bug when weapons fired in the menu.
 Now the default settings are high.
 Inventory sound is now 2 times quieter.
 Reduced the time of crafting buildings.
 Now FPS is displayed correctly.
 Fixed a bug with the fact that the weapon did not make sounds when fired, making it difficult to detect the enemy
 Fixed proximity checker.
 The game server has been moved to a more powerful dedicated server.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 04/14/2020
notes.notes:
[olist]
 Slightly changed graphics.
 Animals no longer spawn on stones and in water.
 Melee weapons now deal damage to players.
 Now you can’t use sprints in squatting.
 Fixed a bug with immortality.
 Doubled the extraction of resources.
 Improved server stability (now the server will not shut down)
 Fixed a bug when walls, stairs, etc. could disappear.
 Added kill command.
 Added settings menu.
 Added potato mode.
 The earth no longer shines.
 Now the grass does not grow on the road.
[/olist]
